newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-UHISPANK LAUNCHES 30 MLN MARK NOTE.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-UHISPANK LAUNCHES 30 MLN MARK NOTE.

text.p: Estonia's Uhispank signed a medium-term note worth 30 million German marks on Monday which is the first stage of its 100 million German mark debt programme, the bank said.

The bank said in a statement that the first issue of its 100 million German mark Debt Issuance Programme will have an interest rate of the German mark Libor plus eight percent and will be led by Chase Manhatten International Limited.
The bank added at a press conference that further issues under the programme will be priced on a case by case basis according to market conditions.
"This should give Uhispank the best opportuntity to pick the best pockets for funds," Matti Copeland, first vice president of Finland's Merita bank, said to Reuters at the signing ceremony.
"Uhispank wants to release the bonds in small lots and this will give the bank flexibity in raising capital," he added.

The Debt Issuance Programme has chosen dealers from ABN Amro Hoare Govett, Chase Manhattan Bank AG, Chase Manhatten International limited, Merrill Lynch Interantional, Merita Bank and Nomura International to place the issue.
The Debt Issuance Programme will be listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange.
